name: Litto
description: Social token launchpad on LighterEVM. Create, discover and trade community coins. Devnet available.
longDescription:
Litto is a social token launchpad on LighterEVM. Create, discover and trade community coins in one workspace.

The app combines token creation, bonding-curve trading, charts, holder data and wallet positions. Trade-linked notes, profiles and following add trader context to each market. Coins that reach the graduation threshold move into Litto's own AMM.

A working devnet application is publicly available at https://dev-test.litto.fun. Visitors can explore markets and charts without connecting a wallet. Transactions use LighterEVM devnet assets.

Litto is currently in devnet testing, with production launch upcoming.
